title: Box–Muller as a pushforward
alt: A unit square gridded into equal-probability cells maps to rings and wedges in the plane; two highlighted cells of equal probability become a small inner sector and a much larger outer one.
caption: Equal probability, unequal area: Box–Muller packs mass near the origin and spreads it thin far away.
data_source: Exact Box–Muller geometry: radii sqrt(-2 log u) for u = 3/4, 1/2, 1/4 (0.7585, 1.1774, 1.6651) and angles 2*pi*k/8.
